title: "[BUG] "

---

🐛 **Bug**  
Describe the bug clearly.

📍 **Location**  
Indicate where the bug happens (feature, page, module, screen, etc.).

❌ **Current Behavior**  
What is happening right now?

✅ **Expected Behavior**  
What should happen instead?

📝 **Notes**  
Add any extra notes, possible causes, screenshots, or implementation hints.

🔗 **Reference**  
Link the PR, issue comment, discussion, or source where this bug was originally reported.

📌 **Resolution Note**  
When this bug is fixed and committed, please comment the commit hash/number on this issue itself.
